This repository builds an n8n community node for VNTANA’s 3D platform. MVP: Products and Authentication. Use **declarative style** - JSON-based routing instead of `execute()` method.

Base URL: `https://api-platform.vntana.com`; authentication uses `X-AUTH-TOKEN`. VNTANA auth: login → refresh-token with organizationUuid; store org-specific token in credentials.

All code must use `httpRequest` - The deprecated `this.helpers.request()` is not allowed

**IMPORTANT:** Before asking the user to test in n8n, verify the implementation works:
All new operations must have unit tests. Run tests before any manual testing:
If it doesn't work with curl, it won't work with n8n. Always verify API calls work:
```sh
curl -X POST "https://api-platform.vntana.com/v1/<endpoint>" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-H "X-AUTH-TOKEN: Bearer <token>" \
npm run build
<REDACTED_USERPATH>/GitHub/VNTANA-n8n-node/.claude/skills/n8n-relink/scripts/relink.sh
```
Only after curl verification succeeds.

**IMPORTANT:** Always bump the version when committing changes to node code (`nodes/` or `credentials/`).
```sh
npm version patch
npm version minor
npm version major
git push origin main --tags
```
Test-only, documentation-only, and CI/CD-only changes do not require bumps.

GitHub repo must be public. Run scanner locally first:
```sh
npx <REDACTED_USER>/scan-community-package n8n-nodes-vntana@latest
```

Before publishing:
```sh
npm run build
npm version patch   # or minor/major
git push origin main --tags
npx <REDACTED_USER>/scan-community-packa
```
